The capital of Australia is Sydney.
questions.explanation: The capital of Australia is Canberra, not Sydney. Sydney is the largest city in Australia, but the seat of government and official capital is Canberra.
questions.hint: Remember that many countries have a separate planned capital city that is different from their biggest or most famous city (e.g., Washington D.C. vs New York).

questions.questionText: Water boils at 100°C at sea level.
questions.explanation: Under standard atmospheric pressure at sea level, the boiling point of pure water is 100°C (212°F). This is a well-established scientific fact.
questions.hint: Think about basic high school chemistry — the temperature at which water turns from liquid to gas under normal conditions.

questions.questionText: The Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye.
questions.explanation: This is a common myth. While the Great Wall is very long, it is not visible from space with the naked eye. Astronauts have confirmed it is difficult to see without aid, similar to many other man-made structures.

questions.questionText: Penguins live only in the Arctic.
questions.explanation: Penguins are native only to the Southern Hemisphere. They live in Antarctica and other southern regions, but not in the Arctic (which is home to polar bears, not penguins).
questions.hint: Polar bears and penguins do not live in the same region — they are on opposite ends of the Earth.

questions.questionText: An adult human body has 206 bones.
questions.explanation: Yes, a typical adult human skeleton consists of 206 bones. Babies are born with more (around 270), but many fuse together as they grow.
questions.hint: Think about basic human anatomy facts taught in biology class.

questions.questionText: Sound travels faster than light.
questions.explanation: Light travels much faster than sound. This is why you see lightning before you hear thunder. The speed of light is approximately 300,000 km/s, while sound travels at about 343 m/s in air.
questions.hint: During a thunderstorm, the flash appears instantly, but the sound arrives later — this demonstrates the speed difference.
